learning.burnASmallHoldingAndObserveSupply: Burn a small holding and observe supply

learning.yourAtaMustHaveAnAvailableBalanceAndNot: Your ATA needs an available balance and must not be frozen. Burning is irreversible; start with a small amount.
learning.burningIsNotSendingTokensElsewhereTheBur: Burning is not sending tokens elsewhere. The burned tokens disappear permanently, but the Mint account remains.
learning.burningDoesNotRevokeMintAuthorityItsHold: Burning does not revoke Mint Authority. Its holder can still issue new tokens while that authority exists.
learning.yourAtaBalanceDecreasesByTheBurnedAmount: Your ATA balance decreases by the burned amount.
learning.mintSupplyDecreasesTheMintAddressAndAuth: Mint supply decreases; the Mint address and authorities remain unchanged.
learning.buildALiquidityPoolFromTwoAssets: Build a liquidity pool from two assets
learning.prepareAMarketThenDepositTheTokenAndSol: Prepare a market, then deposit the token and SOL. Learn the different roles of pools, vaults and LP tokens.
learning.requiresTokenHoldingsDepositSolAndExtraS: Requires token holdings, deposit SOL and extra SOL for costs. Classic SPL Token / WSOL only.
learning.aMarketIsNotAPool: A market is not a pool
learning.thisLegacyAmmV4FlowRequiresAnOpenbookMar: This legacy AMM V4 flow requires an OpenBook market. A ready market is only a prerequisite; both assets must still be deposited to create the pool.
learning.lpTokensRepresentAPoolShareTheLpMint: LP tokens represent a pool share. The LP Mint identifies the token type, not your LP account or the amount received.
learning.protocolFeesAndRentCanFarExceedATransfer: Protocol fees and rent can far exceed a transfer, and full fee estimates are unavailable. Multiple transactions do not roll back together. There is no liquidity removal interface or return guarantee.
learning.marketAndPoolMintsCorrectlyMatchTheInten: Market and pool Mints correctly match the intended Mint / WSOL pair.
learning.savePoolIdMarketIdAndEachSignatureCheck: Save Pool ID, Market ID and each signature. Check actual balances and LP receipts.
learning.addLiquidityToAnExistingPool: Add liquidity to an existing pool
learning.depositBothAssetsAtThePoolRatioUnderstan: Deposit both assets at the pool ratio. Understand estimated amounts, maximum deposits and LP increases.
learning.obtainTheActualAmmV4PoolIdAndBoth: Obtain the actual AMM V4 Pool ID and both assets, plus fee SOL. Do not enter a Market ID as the Pool ID.
learning.bothAmountsFollowThePoolRatio: Both amounts follow the pool ratio
learning.enterABaseAmountTheSdkEstimatesTheOther: Enter a base amount; the SDK estimates the other side. Ratios can change, so an estimate is not a promise of actual debits.
learning.thisLessonUsesAFixed1BoundOnThe: This lesson uses a fixed 1% bound on the other-side deposit. It is rechecked before submission; exceeding the reviewed maximum requires a new quote.
learning.verifyYourLpBalanceIncreaseAfterDepositi: Verify the increase in your LP balance after depositing. This app currently supports adding liquidity, not removing it.
learning.theLoadedPoolIdAndBothMintsIdentifyThe: The loaded Pool ID and both Mints identify the intended pool.
learning.checkActualDebitsAndLpIncreasesFeesAreAd: Check actual debits and LP increases. Fees are additional.
learning.chooseInputAndOutputTokensUnderstandEsti: Choose input and output tokens. Understand estimates, minimum received, slippage and price impact.
learning.requiresAnAvailableDevnetAmmV4PoolForThe: The pair needs an available AMM V4 pool. Prepare input assets and extra SOL for fees.
learning.estimatesReflectCurrentPoolStateMinimumR: Estimates reflect current pool state. Minimum received is an instruction constraint: the trade cannot execute under that constraint below the minimum.
learning.slippageIsTheQuoteMovementYouAllowPriceI: Slippage is the quote movement you allow. Price impact reflects how this trade’s size affects the pool price. They are different measures.
learning.theSamePoolIsReadAgainBeforeSubmissionAn: The same pool is read again before submission. An expired quote or changed minimum needs reconfirmation. An unrelated default pool is never substituted.
learning.checkThatInputOutputMintsDirectionAndPoo: Check that input/output Mints, direction and Pool ID match the preview.
learning.verifyActualBalanceChangesAndTheMinimumR: Verify actual balance changes and the minimum received constraint. SOL also pays fees.
learning.enterACompleteValidSolanaAddressYourInpu: Enter a complete, valid Solana address. Your input is not changed automatically.
learning.enterADecimalAmountGreaterThan0WithoutA: Enter a decimal amount greater than 0, without a minus sign, scientific notation or extra leading zeros.
